topic: Get chewing gum out of fabric
core_question: How do I get gum out of clothing? (secondary: How do I keep squirrels from digging up my flower bulbs?)
answer_summary: Harden the gum with an ice cube or by freezing the garment, then scrape the brittle gum off with a dull knife or spoon edge.; after the topic shift: Lay a sheet of chicken wire or hardware cloth over the freshly planted bulb bed, pinned down, until shoots emerge.
